select cls,
  cast(fish_date_doy/10 as int)*10 as doy_bin,
  sum(yt) as yt, sum(anglers) as anglers, count(*) as n,
  round(sum(yt)/nullif(sum(anglers),0),3) as ypa
from trips
where fish_date_season=2 and fish_date_doy between 100 and 152
group by 1,2
order by 2,1

select cls, boat, fish_date_doy, sum(yt) yt, sum(anglers) anglers, count(*) n
from trips
where fish_date_season=2 and fish_date_doy between 138 and 152 and cls in ('overnight','day_1_5')
group by 1,2,3
order by 3,1,2
